definitions.visit: one arrival at the infoset as the non-updating player in external-sampling MCCFR (each adds one probability vector to strategy_sum); infosets reached only as the updating player have 0 visits
definitions.newly_discovered: infoset absent at the previous checkpoint
definitions.meaningfully_trained: reported at three fixed thresholds: >= 5, >= 10, >= 20 visits; none is privileged
definitions.l1: sum of absolute probability differences; maximum possible 2.0

seed_disagreement.note: unvisited (uniform-fallback) infosets are excluded from every L1 average
